title: Just Gotta Get Right Outta Here

contact_edits.before: What else? Spectators are issued with little green light-sticks that they obediently wave in the air. Audiences (and not just for this show): Refuse participation. You have nothing to gain but your self-respect. Arlene Phillips choreography might be excused on the grounds that those who execute it are supposed to be robots, but couldn't the robots have been more imaginatively programmed? Elton's script does run to a few good jokes, all of them crammed into one scene in the second act and entrusted to a pickled hippie, played with pleasing relish by Jack Langeduk. But even he is only there to fulfill the show's main purpose, which is to make a narcissistic generation feel nostalgically good about itself. - We Will Rock You plays until May 27. Call 416-872- 1212 for ticket information.
